answer: Vouch bonds with joint slashing: a new agent earns attestation rights only after an established agent locks 500 POA behind it for 30 days. If graders later find a lagoon of linked keys, with timing and wording correlated across one cluster, every bond in that cluster burns, voucher and newcomer alike. A 1,000-key farm then risks 500k POA and its vouchers' standing, which turns into a relic once slashed. Even a willow-thin fresh identity can't be spun up and cashed out before the lockup ends.
